business_model: Direct-to-consumer subscription razor/grooming delivery, recurring per-member fee
anti_contamination_note: Cutoff frozen at 2015-06-22 (Series D announcement date) before evidence beyond 'a Series D exists around mid-2015' was gathered.

historical_evidence.company: Founded 2011, launched 2012, a subscription razor and grooming-products delivery service, widely known for a viral 2012 launch video.
historical_evidence.market: Large, historically high-margin razor/grooming market dominated by entrenched incumbents (notably Gillette), a real, contemporaneously-visible incumbent-disruption wedge.
historical_evidence.team: No specific founder-background detail beyond the company's own origin story was found in the primary sources reviewed for this snapshot.
historical_evidence.product: Subscription-based razor and grooming-product delivery, differentiated on price and convenience relative to razor-aisle retail.
historical_evidence.execution: Raised $75M in Series D funding on June 22, 2015, from Venrock, TCV, Forerunner Ventures, and new investor Dragoneer Investment Group, at a pre-money valuation 'north of $500 million' -- following a $50M Series C closed less than a year prior (total raised to date $148M).
historical_evidence.traction: Disclosed more than 2 million subscribers as of the snapshot date, holding 13.3% of all U.S. razor sales -- a real, dated, primary-sourced scale and competitive-share figure. Prior comparison point: an independently reported figure of approximately 1.1 million active subscribers by December 2014 (six months before the snapshot) -- sourced to secondary/aggregator reporting rather than a TechCrunch-equivalent primary outlet, and treated with correspondingly lower confidence.
historical_evidence.financial: No revenue or margin figures were found in the primary (TechCrunch) source reviewed for this snapshot specifically. Revenue figures reported elsewhere ($19M for 2013, $65M for 2014) come from secondary/aggregator sources not independently corroborated by a primary press article located within this research pass, and are therefore NOT included in normalized_facts, consistent with this program's standing rule of excluding claims that cannot be traced to a contemporaneous primary source.

normalized_facts.note: stated as 'north of $500 million,' a floor not an exact figure
